The first row is multilevel bias minus single-level bias, 0.151 versus 0.152, magnitude larger, same direction, verdict close. The approximate-weight row is 0.157 versus 0.156, magnitude same, verdict close, because 0.156 does not round to 0.157. The Bernoulli row is not established.
Bernoulli and random-coefficient arms are named as unrun, with the printed Bernoulli contrast -0.170 left without an estimate.
The abstract says the Bernoulli outcome and the random-coefficient model were not rerun, and it reports the coverage gap 0.282 versus 0.248.
Numerical labels are separated from the Monte Carlo standard errors stated in the preceding section. The bands are not called equivalence.
Koziol (2015) is named, the outperform sentence matches the dissertation abstract, and the biases match Table C.2 for the named cell.
The 0.001 tolerance is the sum of two half-thousandth bounds. 0.152 against 0.151 is larger; 0.156 against 0.157 is same; the missing Bernoulli estimate is not established.
